# Tidepool Landing Page: Revised Build Plan

**Global**
- Max content width 1200px, 8px spacing grid, 96px vertical padding between sections (64px on mobile).
- Type: Fraunces for headings, Inter for body and UI. Body 18px, line height 1.6.
- Palette: sand #F7F5F0 (background), ink #1F2A2E (text), deep teal #0E4D52 (headings, accents), seafoam #A8DCD0 (backdrops), coral #E0553F (CTAs only). Coral buttons use ink text, not white, to meet WCAG AA.
- Motion: 200ms fade-up on scroll, disabled under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Every section has a visible heading for screen readers and a single primary action at most.

**1. Header**
- Layout: Logo left, links (Product, Pricing, Log in) center-right, "Start free" button right. Sticky.
- Visual: Sand background, 1px hairline appears after 16px scroll.
- Copy: Nav labels only.

**2. Hero**
- Layout: Text 55%, product visual 45% on desktop. Stacks on mobile with the screenshot below the CTAs.
- Visual: Fraunces 60px headline with "week" in teal. A real screenshot of the shared week board with four named teammates, slightly tilted, on a seafoam blob. Screenshot uses realistic data, not lorem ipsum.
- Copy: Headline: "The week your whole team can see." Subhead: "Tidepool turns scattered messages into one shared plan your small team will actually keep." Primary: "Start planning free." Secondary: "Watch the 2-minute tour" (opens an inline video with captions). Microcopy: "Free for teams of up to 5. No credit card."

**3. Proof strip**
- Layout: Single row of six customer logos, centered, wrapping to two rows on mobile.
- Visual: Grayscale at 60% opacity, full color on hover.
- Copy: "Used by teams of 2 to 12 people." If fewer than six approved logos exist at launch, replace the row with a single pull-quote from a named customer. Never show placeholder logos.

**4. Problem**
- Layout: Narrow centered column, three statements with large Fraunces numerals in teal.
- Visual: Generous whitespace, no imagery.
- Copy: "1. Plans live in chat. 2. Tasks live in a doc. 3. Deadlines live in a calendar. 4. Who's doing what lives in someone's head." Closing line: "Tidepool puts them in one place."

**5. How it works**
- Layout: Three cards in a row, stacked on mobile. Each has a coral numeral and a 16px-radius white card with soft shadow.
- Visual: Each card includes a small UI fragment (add task, assign chip, workload bar).
- Copy: "Add the week." "Claim the work." "Check the tide." One sentence under each explaining the action in under 15 words.

**6. Feature rows**
- Layout: Two alternating rows, image and text swapping sides. Each row has one CTA-free text link.
- Visual: Real UI captures in rounded frames on seafoam backdrops.
- Copy: Outcome-first headlines. Row 1: "See who's overloaded before Tuesday." Row 2: "Turn Slack messages into tasks in one click."

**7. Testimonials**
- Layout: Three quote cards, horizontal scroll on mobile.
- Visual: Circular photo avatars, quotes in Fraunces italic 22px.
- Copy: Each quote includes name, role, team size, and one measurable result (for example, "cut our Monday planning from 45 minutes to 10"). Use only quotes with written permission.

**8. Pricing**
- Layout: Three columns. "Team" is the middle card with a 2px teal border and "Most popular" tag. Monthly/annual toggle above, with annual saving stated in plain numbers.
- Visual: Up to six feature bullets per tier, with check icons in teal.
- Copy: Tier names "Free," "Team," "Studio." Limits stated plainly: "Up to 5 people," "Unlimited weeks," "Slack and calendar sync." Below the grid: "Cancel anytime. Export everything as CSV."

**9. FAQ**
- Layout: Single-column accordion, six questions, first one open by default.
- Copy: Cover what happens after the free plan ends (you keep read-only access to past weeks), Slack and calendar integrations, importing from Google Docs or Notion, how data is deleted, whether teammates need paid seats, and whether there's a mobile app.

**10. Final CTA**
- Layout: Full-width teal band, centered, 480px max text width.
- Visual: White Fraunces headline, one coral button with ink text, seafoam wave at the bottom edge.
- Copy: "Make next Monday shorter." Button: "Start this week, free." Supporting line: "Set up in under five minutes."

**11. Footer**
- Layout: Four link columns (Product, Company, Resources, Legal), wordmark and copyright in a bottom row.
- Visual: Thin wave divider at top, sand background, ink text.
- Copy: Include a privacy-first line: "We never sell your team's data."

**Changes from the prior plan:** Fixed coral-button contrast, replaced placeholder logo guidance with a fallback, added the tour video spec, made the FAQ and testimonials concrete, and added mobile behavior for the hero, cards, and testimonials.
